resolved in the INC-201 postmortem that every in-memory cache in this service must be bounded to at most 1024 entries and drop its oldest key first once that limit is passed. the trigger was a memoization layer added to the geo module that grew without any upper bound; over roughly six weeks the pod's resident memory climbed until the container hit an out-of-memory kill in production. the review conclusion was that an unbounded map keyed on request data is never acceptable here
